build_vae_model: build a VAE model by instantiating the VAE class with an encoder and decoder network
run_vae_elbo: run the VAE ELBO computation on input data to get reconstruction fidelity and KL divergence
run_avae_elbo: run the AVAE ELBO computation with auxiliary latent variables using the rho parameter
reconstruct_data_with_vae: reconstruct input data by calling the VAE instance to encode, sample, and decode latent representations
review_vae_elbo_vs_avae_elbo: review the difference between standard VAE ELBO and AVAE ELBO which adds conditional latent terms
